final_message:
I implemented `parsePorts`, `normalizePorts`, and `countPorts` in `src/ports.ts` following the README. All 3 tests pass with `npm test`.

I also checked the edge cases by hand: merging of touching and separated ranges, canonical output spacing, empty input, and every error case in the README (empty items, non-numeric input, out-of-range ports, reversed ranges) all behave as specified.

I couldn't run `tsc` because the npm registry returned 403, so the strict type-check is unverified. The tests run TypeScript directly through Node's type stripping.
